response.justification: Strong overall fit: 15+ years of full-stack engineering with recent, relevant TypeScript/Node.js work (Optilyz, RIDE Capital, re:cinq), plus React, MongoDB, AWS CDK, Docker/Kubernetes and a demonstrably deep testing culture (built a D test runner and assertion library, taught TDD/Selenium courses). Current role explicitly covers AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which directly matches a hard-to-source requirement. Gaps are mostly framework-specific (no stated Nest.js or Vitest) and a large share of career depth sits in DLang rather than the JVM secondary stack, but these are readily bridgeable for an engineer at this level. Worth an interview focused on Nest.js/React depth and architecture ownership.
strengths: Recent hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling experience — rare and directly on-spec
Deep TypeScript/Node.js + React/MongoDB/AWS/Kubernetes full-stack track record
Exceptional testing and craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, authored test tooling, teaches workshops)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js or Vitest experience listed; framework ramp-up needed
Kotlin/Java exposure is dated (Altom, 2016–2018) and secondary
Significant depth invested in DLang/niche stacks rather than the target enterprise stack
